Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) IPv4 and IPv6 ranges, from the prefixes its verified autonomous systems announce, read live from the RIPEstat Data API (https://stat.ripe.net/). Alibaba Cloud publishes no address-space feed of its own. This is general-purpose rented compute: the tenant behind any given address changes constantly and an attacker can simply rent one.
